relations.rationale: The queue growing at a bakery is consistent with a bakery atmosphere but does not establish the cinnamon smell.
A slowly growing queue chatting about harvest has no bearing on Yara writing down custom cake orders.
A growing queue of neighbours chatting is consistent with more villagers wandering in, suggesting increasing activity.
The queue growing due to chatting about harvest does not indicate why villagers were drawn there.
A slowly growing queue with chatting neighbours suggests a cheerful, busy atmosphere consistent with the bakery buzzing.
Fay being taller than Isla says nothing about Isla's height relative to Yara.
Fay's height relative to Isla has no connection to the baker being an older man named Ross.
Fay being taller than Isla alone doesn't determine her height relative to Yara without knowing Isla-Yara comparison.
Fay's height compared to Isla has no bearing on Fay laughing while balancing trays.
Bunting being strung outside has no connection to the identity of the baker.
Bunting outside the bakery is unrelated to Yara recording custom cake orders.
Bunting strung between lamp posts has no bearing on the delivery van needing fuel.
Bunting being strung suggests festive preparation, which could support more villagers coming, but it's a weak indirect link.
The bunting fluttering in the morning air has no bearing on Sami checking the stallholder list.
Isla being taller than Yara, combined with an implied chain, could support Fay being taller than Yara, but on its own doesn't establish it.
Isla's height compared to Yara has no bearing on the delivery van needing fuel.
Finn offering to carry trays has no bearing on the baker's identity.
Finn's offer to carry heavier trays for Yara doesn't directly cause or relate to Fay laughing while balancing trays.
Finn helping Yara rearrange pastries doesn't directly relate to Fay's carefulness with icing.
Finn's helpful offer contributes to a cooperative, busy atmosphere consistent with the bakery buzzing with cheerful activity.
